panels.name: Compute Availability Errors
EC2 Availability Error Rates Per Minute
panels.queryString:
// id=@user_serviceavailability_ec2
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail
AwsApiCall ec2 errorCode (Server.Unavailable OR Server.InternalFailure OR Server.ServiceUnavailable OR Server.InternalError)
| parse "\"awsRegion\":\"*\"" as awsRegion
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as eventSource
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName
| parse "\"eventType\":\"*\"" as eventType
| parse "\"recipientAccountId\":\"*\"" as accountId
| parse field=eventSource "*.amazonaws.com" as resourceType
| parse "\"errorCode\":\"*\"" as errorCode
| where eventType = "AwsApiCall" and resourceType = "ec2" and errorCode in ("Server.Unavailable", "Server.InternalFailure", "Server.ServiceUnavailable", "Server.InternalError")
| timeslice 1m
| concat(resourceType, "_", eventName, "_", errorCode, "_", awsRegion, "_", accountId) as aggregate
| count by aggregate, _timeslice
| sort + _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1m)
| join
( compose aggregate keywords | 1 as tmp ) as t1,
( max(_count) by _timeslice, aggregate | 1 as tmp ) as t2
on t1.tmp = t2.tmp
| t2__timeslice as _timeslice
| t2_aggregate as real_aggregate
| t2__max as _count
| t1__compose as field_list
| fields _timeslice, real_aggregate, _count, field_list
| parse regex field=field_list "\"(?<aggregate>[^\"]+)\"" multi
| if(isNull(real_aggregate) || real_aggregate = aggregate, _count, 0) as _count
| max(_count) as _count by aggregate,  _timeslice
| parse field=aggregate "*_*_*_*_*" as resourceType, eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, accountId
| concat("resourceType=", resourceType, "_eventName=", eventName, "_errorCode=", errorCode, "_awsRegion=", awsRegion) as benchmarkName
| fields _count, benchmarkName, accountId, _timeslice
| pct(_count,99) as my_company_p99, max(_count) as my_company_max by benchmarkName, accountId
| where my_company_max > 0
| infer _category=cloudtraildevops _model=benchmark benchmarktype=service_availability stat=p99,max
| p99 as benchmark_p99 | max as benchmark_max
| parse field=benchmarkName "resourceType=ec2_eventName=*_errorCode=*_awsRegion=*" as eventName, errorCode, awsRegion
| fields eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, accountId, my_company_p99, my_company_max, benchmark_max, benchmark_p99
| max(my_company_p99) as my_company_p99, max(my_company_max) as my_company_max, max(benchmark_max) as benchmark_max, max(benchmark_p99) as benchmark_p99 by eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, accountId

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail
AwsApiCall lambda errorCode Invoke (EC2ThrottledException OR TooManyRequestsException)
| parse "\"awsRegion\":\"*\"" as awsRegion
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as eventSource
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName
| parse "\"eventType\":\"*\"" as eventType
| parse "\"recipientAccountId\":\"*\"" as accountId
| parse field=eventSource "*.amazonaws.com" as resourceType
| parse "\"errorCode\":\"*\"" as errorCode
| parse "\"functionName\":\"*\"" as functionName
| where eventType = "AwsApiCall" and resourceType = "lambda" and eventName = "Invoke" and errorCode in ("EC2ThrottledException", "TooManyRequestsException")
| timeslice 1m
| concat(resourceType, "_", eventName, "_", errorCode, "_", awsRegion, "_", accountId, "_", functionName) as aggregate
| count by aggregate, _timeslice
| sort + _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1m)
| join
( compose aggregate keywords | 1 as tmp ) as t1,
( max(_count) by _timeslice, aggregate | 1 as tmp ) as t2
on t1.tmp = t2.tmp
| t2__timeslice as _timeslice
| t2_aggregate as real_aggregate
| t2__max as _count
| t1__compose as field_list
| fields _timeslice, real_aggregate, _count, field_list
| parse regex field=field_list "\"(?<aggregate>[^\"]+)\"" multi
| if(isNull(real_aggregate) || real_aggregate = aggregate, _count, 0) as _count
| max(_count) as _count by aggregate,  _timeslice
| parse field=aggregate "*_*_*_*_*_*" as resourceType, eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, accountId, functionName
| pct(_count,99) as my_company_p99, max(_count) as my_company_max by resourceType, eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, accountId, functionName

// id=@config_lambda_categorical_values
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail
AwsApiCall lambda !errorCode (Runtime or Mode)
| parse "\"awsRegion\":\"*\"" as awsRegion
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as eventSource
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName
| parse "\"eventType\":\"*\"" as eventType
| parse "\"recipientAccountId\":\"*\"" as accountId
| parse field=eventSource "*.amazonaws.com" as resourceType
| parse "\"functionName\":\"*\"" as functionName nodrop
| where eventType = "AwsApiCall" and resourceType = "lambda"
| parse "\"mode\":\"*\"" as mode nodrop
| if(isBlank(mode), "Not-Available", mode) as mode
| parse "\"runtime\":\"*\"" as runtime nodrop
| if(isBlank(runtime), "Not-Available", runtime) as runtime
| concat("mode=", mode, ",runtime=", runtime) as benchmarkNames
| count_distinct(functionName) by benchmarkNames, awsRegion
| parse regex field=benchmarkNames "(?<benchmarkname>[^,]+)" multi
| where !(benchmarkname matches "*Not-Available*")
| parse field=benchmarkname "*=" as configProperty
| concat("resourceType=lambda_", benchmarkname, "_awsRegion=", awsRegion) as benchmarkname
| concat(configProperty, "_", awsRegion) as denomGroup
| fields benchmarkname, _count_distinct, denomGroup
| join
(sum(_count_distinct) as denom by denomGroup) as t1,
(sum(_count_distinct) as val by denomGroup, benchmarkName) as t2
on t1.denomGroup = t2.denomGroup
| t2_val as val
| t2_benchmarkname as benchmarkname
| t1_denom as denom
| concat(round(toDouble(val) / denom * 10000) / 100, "%") as my_company_percentage
| infer _category=cloudtraildevops _model=benchmark benchmarktype=categorical
| concat(round(percentage * 10000) / 100, "%") as benchmark_percentage
| parse field=benchmarkname "resourceType=lambda_*=*_awsRegion=*" as configProperty, value, awsRegion
| fields awsRegion, configProperty, value, my_company_percentage, benchmark_percentage
| sort +awsRegion, +configProperty, +value

| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as eventSource
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName
| parse "\"eventType\":\"*\"" as eventType
| parse "\"recipientAccountId\":\"*\"" as accountId
| parse field=eventSource "*.amazonaws.com" as resourceType
| parse "\"errorCode\":\"*\"" as errorCode
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as userName
| parse "\"tableName\":\"*\"" as tableName nodrop
| where eventType = "AwsApiCall" and resourceType = "dynamodb" and errorCode in ("ProvisionedThroughputExceededException", "ThrottlingException")
| timeslice 1m
|where if ("{{accountid}}" = "*", true, accountid matches "{{accountid}}") AND if ("{{awsRegion}}" = "*", true, awsRegion matches "{{awsRegion}}")
|count by userName, awsRegion, accountId, resourceType, eventName, tableName, errorCode, _timeslice
| max(_count) as my_company_errorsPerMin by userName, awsRegion, accountId, resourceType, eventName, tableName, errorCode
| fields userName, awsRegion, accountId, resourceType, eventName, tableName, errorCode, my_company_errorsPerMin
| topk (3, my_company_errorsPerMin)
| fields -_rank
